baseline_models.focus_anchor: The posture in mttkyn, the couches in al-araik, and the paired negation of shams and zamharir.
baseline_models.mechanism: Supported bodies occupy a furnished, sheltered interior whose experienced range excludes both solar exposure and severe cold. The two excluded poles define repose as thermal equilibrium rather than mere softness of furniture.

activation_trace.role: Leaning on a support supplies the weight-bearing posture and makes repose a transfer of bodily load.
A couch within a curtained chamber supplies both the furnishing and its sheltered interior.
Seeing by eye or insight makes the double negation describe the occupants' experienced field.
Sun and daylight supply the exposed or hot pole removed from the setting.
Intense cold supplies the opposite thermal pole, closing the comfort interval.

changed_reading.before: They recline on couches in a place without sun or severe cold.
changed_reading.after: They are bodily supported inside a protected thermal interval in which neither environmental extreme reaches their experience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The clause says that they do not see, rather than merely do not feel, the sun and zamharir.
baseline_models.mechanism: The curtained couch and the verb of seeing make the line architectural and perceptual: ordinary celestial markers are absent from view. The flashing-stars branch of zamharir gives the otherwise nonvisual cold term a secondary visual edge, so both daytime disk and nocturnal flash can be held outside the chamber's visual regime.

activation_trace.role: The curtained couch supplies a bounded visual interior rather than an exposed seat.
Visible appearance foregrounds what is admitted to or excluded from the scene.
The solar disk and daylight provide the ordinary daytime luminary excluded from view.
Severe cold preserves the surface thermal contrast while the clause remains perceptually phrased.
Flashing stars supply an exploratory nocturnal visual counterpart to the absent sun.

changed_reading.after: The verse also sketches a protected field of vision independent of the ordinary daytime and nighttime luminaries.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The supported posture and the negated shams and zamharir remain explicit, while their inventories also carry restiveness, hostility, anger, and healing.
baseline_models.mechanism: A wound settles on the couch while restive hostility and the red-eyed intensity of anger are absent. On this branch-level reading, thermal quiet doubles as social and affective quiet.

activation_trace.role: Reliance on support supplies bodily release rather than defensive readiness.
A wound settling as it heals turns the couch into a site of recovered calm.
Displayed hostility supplies one affective pressure removed by the negation.
Eyes reddened by anger supply the other affective pressure removed from the scene.

changed_reading.before: No heat or cold disturbs the recliners.
changed_reading.after: No hostility or angry gaze disturbs a supported, healed state; climatic balance carries an exploratory affective overlay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with a moment inside extended time, later schedules remembrance by morning, evening, and night, and contrasts the immediate with a heavy day. Against that clocked corridor, the absence of sun and severe cold lets the recliners' settled stay read as release from diurnal, seasonal, and urgent temporal pressure.

activation_trace.role: Staying fixed in a place supplies durable residence rather than a passing pause.
Sun and daylight provide the most visible marker of the daily cycle now absent.
Severe cold provides a seasonal extreme whose absence widens the release beyond one day.
A thing's appointed time opens the surah's clocked human corridor.
Extended time enlarges that corridor beyond a single appointed moment.
The day's severe event gives time an oppressive weight from which repose contrasts.
The beginning of day marks one edge of the earthly remembrance schedule.
Evening marks the other daily edge and makes the schedule cyclical.
Night and its darkness extend disciplined time beyond daylight.
Haste and priority supply the pressure of the immediate world.
Weight opposed to lightness makes the deferred day temporally burdensome.

structural_cues: 76:1 begins in a named moment within extended time, while 76:25-26 divides devotion across morning, evening, and night.
76:27 opposes the immediate attraction to a heavy future day; 76:13 removes the sun from the reward scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple temporal markers, a ritual schedule, urgency, weight, and absent sun/cold; I infer that climatic release also suspends clock-pressure. A live alternative is that these are independent time references and 76:13 remains only meteorological.

changed_reading.after: Their settled repose is also outside the cycles and urgencies that partition earthly human time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, linked rings and collars bind condemned bodies. Around the recliners, by contrast, bodies remain settled while vessels circulate, containers fit their measure, and an encircling band becomes adornment. The mechanics of constraint are reversed: persons are supported and objects move for them.

activation_trace.role: Fastening a container supplies a latent binding image inside the reclining posture.
Remaining fixed in place makes the recliners' stillness deliberate rather than imposed.
Connected rings supply the earlier mechanism that fixes punitive restraint to bodies.
A collar binding a limb sharpens the body's earlier loss of free disposition.
Circulation around something transfers motion from the rewarded bodies to serving objects and agents.
The vessel supplies a benign container that moves toward the recliners rather than binding them.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure makes containment responsive to its recipient.
A band encircling the wrist converts enclosure from punitive collar to ornament.

structural_cues: 76:4 attaches chains and collars to the condemned; 76:15-16 makes fitted vessels circulate around the rewarded.
The stable participle in 76:13 contrasts with the repeated passive and active circling in 76:15 and 76:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding objects, settled recliners, circulating measured vessels, and bracelets; I infer a deliberate reversal in who or what is constrained and mobile. A live alternative is that punishment and luxury are only parallel contrasts without a shared mechanics of enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Reclining simply signifies luxury and inactivity.
changed_reading.after: Reclining is free stillness after imposed restraint: bodies are supported while bounded objects circulate responsively around them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flowing water, protective garden enclosure, near overhead shade, tractable hanging fruit, and exact measure form an actively regulated habitat. The double thermal exclusion is therefore not an empty lack but the output of a responsive ecology that brings cover, provision, and fit toward the occupants.

activation_trace.role: Supported leaning locates the body at the stable center of the regulated setting.
The curtained couch gives the responsive ecology a sheltered inhabited center.
Solar exposure is the upper environmental extreme the habitat excludes.
Severe cold is the lower environmental extreme the habitat excludes.
A wide opening with outflow supplies controllable water movement within the garden system.
Protective covering makes the garden an enclosure that wards rather than confines.
Nearness makes shelter approach the occupants instead of requiring their movement.
An overhead canopy supplies the physical regulator of exposure.
Making difficulty tractable turns hanging provision into a responsive feature of the habitat.
Exact fit and a middle limit generalize environmental moderation into material measure.

structural_cues: 76:12-16 places 76:13 between garden reward and shade, fruit, vessels, and exact measure.
The repeated spatial orientation toward and over the occupants makes amenities converge on the reclined center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, flow, nearness, facilitated fruit, and fitted vessels around the thermal statement; I infer one regulated ecological mechanism. A live alternative is a serial inventory of independent delights rather than an integrated habitat.

changed_reading.before: The place happens to lack uncomfortable weather.
changed_reading.after: A measured, flowing, protective habitat actively maintains a habitable middle around the supported occupants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The righteous first bind themselves to a vow, complete it, and hold themselves through fear and endurance; then protection and recompense reach them. Reclining becomes a transfer of load: after they carried obligation, the couch carries them and divine protection carries the danger away.

activation_trace.role: Reliance on a support supplies the final transfer of weight away from the body.
The furnished couch is the concrete bearer that receives the released load.
Completion without deficiency supplies the agents' fully carried obligation.
Self-imposed obligation gives that prior carrying a voluntary binding form.
Action answered by recompense supplies the causal hinge from endurance to repose.
Damage pushed away by protection removes the danger they had anticipated.
Holding the self back from distress supplies the sustained inner load now released.

structural_cues: 76:7-12 moves from vow and fear through warding and recompense directly into the participle mttkyn in 76:13.
The causal bi-ma sabaru in 76:12 explicitly places endurance immediately before supported repose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary obligation, completion, self-restraint, protection, recompense, and physical support; I infer a transfer-of-load relation. A live alternative is the simpler sequence in which the couch is reward without mirroring the prior burden.

changed_reading.before: The couch is an external luxury awarded after patience.
changed_reading.after: The supported posture reverses the agents' earlier load-bearing: fulfilled obligation gives way to being physically and protectively borne.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear of a frowning, densely severe day is answered by protection, inward joy, and finally mercy. That reversal activates the focus branches of a healed wound, displayed hostility, and anger-reddened eyes: the reclined setting excludes threatening faces and affective weather as well as literal climate.

activation_trace.role: A wound settling after improvement supplies recovery from prior threat.
Open hostility supplies an affective heat or pressure barred from the setting.
Anger visible in reddened eyes supplies a threatening gaze barred by the paired negation.
Expected harm supplies the anticipatory affect that precedes the reward scene.
A face contracted by distress or anger personifies the threatening day.
Pervasive severity intensifies the hostile atmosphere from which the occupants are removed.
Protection that pushes damage away supplies the transition into safety.
Inward joy and ease provide the positive affect filling the cleared field.
Mercy and tenderness extend safety from a momentary mood into the surah's closing relation.

structural_cues: 76:10 gives the feared day a hostile facial expression; 76:11 immediately replaces harm with radiance and joy.
76:31 closes the surah by contrasting entry into mercy with painful punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear, a frowning severe face, protection, joy, mercy, and focus branches for hostility and angry eyes; I infer that weather imagery carries an affective-safety layer. A live alternative is to retain only the literal thermal contrast and treat the emotional sequence as adjacent reward language.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants are safe from uncomfortable temperatures.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit a healed social field with no hostile display or angry gaze, while the literal climatic reading remains primary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who fed vulnerable others without asking return become the still center toward which shade, fruit, vessels, and drink move, and their effort is acknowledged as recompensed work. Reclining is thus not idle status but the reciprocal reversal of one-way service.

activation_trace.role: Supported repose fixes the former servers as recipients rather than movers.
Feeding another supplies the earlier outward movement of provision.
Recompense answering action supplies the reversal from giver to recipient.
Approaching nearness makes shelter and provision come toward them.
Circulation around the recliners turns service inward toward the former feeders.
Work and earning identify the repose as an answer to purposeful prior effort.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 emphasizes feeding without requested recompense or thanks; 76:14-21 repeatedly directs amenities toward the occupants.
76:22 names both recompense and acknowledged effort after the service sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unrequited feeding, approaching amenities, circulating service, recompense, and acknowledged work; I infer reciprocal reversal rather than aristocratic idleness. A live alternative is that these are generic rewards with no role-reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Reclining marks elevated leisure after charitable deeds.
changed_reading.after: The former one-way givers may finally remain still while provision comes to them, making repose an ethical reciprocity.

context_deltas.mechanism: After 76:13 negates seeing two harsh environmental markers, 76:19-20 repeatedly commands or describes seeing persons, pearl-like brilliance, bliss, and dominion. The negative field is selective rather than blank: harmful or governing sights disappear so rewarded reality can fill vision.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight anchors the contrast between excluded and admitted objects.
Sun and daylight supply one governing sight removed from the field.
Severe cold supplies the opposite harmful condition removed from experience.
Radiant freshness provides an early positive replacement for the excluded harsh field.
Repeated seeing reopens the visual field and explicitly directs it toward reward.
Gleaming brilliance makes the newly admitted human scene visibly luminous.
Flourishing good condition names the content that now occupies sight.

structural_cues: The negated yarawna of 76:13 is followed by raaytahum in 76:19 and the doubled raayta in 76:20.
76:19-20 supplies concrete visible contents immediately after the environmental exclusions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative seeing clause followed by emphatic repeated seeing and luminous content; I infer visual curation rather than absence of vision. A live alternative is that yarawna is idiomatic for exposure while the later repetition is rhetorically unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The lack of sun could suggest a dim or visually empty shelter.
changed_reading.after: Vision is abundant but curated: harsh environmental governors vanish, while radiant persons, bliss, and dominion become visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: With the sun and even the star-flash branch of zamharir absent, brightness is redistributed through radiant faces, silver vessels, pearl-like attendants, flourishing green cloth, and adornment. Illumination becomes immanent in persons and gifts rather than imposed by a remote celestial source.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance makes the source and distribution of brightness part of the scene's logic.
The absent sun supplies the ordinary centralized source of daylight.
Flashing stars supply an exploratory second celestial source also held outside the setting.
Fresh radiance relocates brightness onto the protected recipients.
Silver supplies reflective brightness embodied in circulating material.
Pearl-like gleaming distributes flashes among moving attendants.
Fresh flourishing color gives the illuminated field living rather than merely metallic saturation.
Adornment makes brightness wearable and locally attached to persons.

structural_cues: 76:11 and 76:15-21 repeatedly place radiance, silver, pearls, green cloth, and ornaments within the reward scene.
These visible materials follow a verse that removes the sun from sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent celestial markers and multiple luminous persons and materials; I infer a distributed replacement-light mechanism. A live alternative is that the items signify beauty and wealth without implying anything about illumination.

changed_reading.before: No sun means the chamber lacks ordinary daylight.
changed_reading.after: The scene can remain brilliant because radiance is distributed through protected bodies and gifts rather than centralized in celestial exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant r-w-y mapping for the QAC root of yarawna. It remains anchored because root_000615/B001 is explicitly supplied for the focus occurrence and the context repeatedly supplies drinking, springs, and watering. Downstream prose should present it only as a mapped-root resonance of quenched embodiment, never as the morphology or primary lexical sense of yarawna.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence yarawna is explicitly mapped in the packet both to dominant seeing branches and to root_000615, whose B001 is quenching and freedom from thirst.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant quenching branch gives seeing a contained bodily-satiety resonance.
Taking in liquid establishes drinking as a recurrent bodily action around the focus scene.
A flowing spring supplies the continuing source from which quenching becomes possible.
Giving drink completes the bodily provision that activates the distant focus branch.

changed_reading.before: They simply do not visually encounter sun or severe cold.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary split-root resonance, their visual shelter is also a fully quenched bodily state no longer exposed to thirst-producing extremes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the labor-posture branch of mttkyn and the healing-wound branch of al-araik. It remains anchored in those exact focus inventories and gains a whole-surah arc from mixed drop through birth imagery to womb-like mercy. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy of post-creation recovery, not an assertion that the surface verse describes childbirth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus roots for mttkyn and al-araik include, respectively, a labor posture and a wound settling as it heals.

activation_trace.role: A laboring posture turns reclining into an exploratory threshold between strain and release.
A wound settling after repair supplies the recovery phase of that threshold.
Generative fluid supplies the surah's initial material state of human formation.
Mixture and interpenetration make formation a compositional process rather than an instant object.
The event of birth keeps generation latent inside the reward population.
The womb branch gives entry into mercy a contained enclosure-and-rebirth resonance.

changed_reading.before: The rewarded simply rest after moral effort.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the supported and healed posture resembles post-formation release: created beings settle after the surah's long generative trial into a mercy-like enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the arak-tree branch of the araik root resonate with the literal couch branch. It remains anchored in the focus root and is independently activated by the packet's arak-fruit, garden, canopy, and hanging-fruit branches. Downstream prose must keep it as a botanical echo that blends furnishing with living shelter, not translate al-araik as trees.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory for al-araik contains both the literal curtained couch and the arak tree under the same root occurrence.

activation_trace.role: The literal curtained couch preserves the surface furnishing and chamber.
The arak tree supplies the exploratory living material that can merge chamber and grove.
Arak fruit provides an unusually specific cross-root activation of the focus tree branch.
A garden hidden by trees supplies the larger vegetative enclosure.
An overhead canopy gives the grove its chamber-like roof.
Near hanging fruit makes the living enclosure materially productive around the couch.

changed_reading.before: The araik are inert couches set somewhere inside the garden.
changed_reading.after: As a contained botanical resonance, couch and grove interpenetrate: the furnishing becomes the inhabited center of a living, fruiting canopy.

strongest_changes: The thermal baseline became an actively regulated habitat of cover, flow, nearness, tractability, and exact fit.
Reclining became a reversal of burden and service: former obligation-bearers and feeders are now supported while provision moves toward them.
Earlier bodily constraint was mechanically reversed into free stillness surrounded by circulating vessels and ornamental bands.
The negative seeing clause became selective visibility and distributed radiance rather than darkness or perceptual lack.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made distant structures matter: creation and extended time at the opening, chains and self-binding before the focus, responsive shade and service after it, repeated seeing and local radiance later, and mercy at the close. It also preserved split and branch-distant activations that a literal thermal summary would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether la yarawna primarily denotes visual exclusion, experiential non-exposure, or deliberately supports both remains unresolved.
The temporal, affective, and distributed-radiance mechanisms are coherent overlays but should not displace the strong literal thermal reading.
The non-dominant r-w-y mapping, labor/healing analogy, and arak-grove echo require explicit exploratory containment in downstream prose.
